title: used to / would / be used to
recall: used to va would farqi nima? be used to va get used to qanday ishlatiladi?
formula: used to + V1: o'tmish odati yoki holati (hozir emas) — I used to live in Samarkand
would + V1: o'tmishdagi takroriy HARAKAT (holat emas) — Every summer we would go to the mountains
be used to + -ing / ot: ko'nikkan; get used to: ko'nika boshlash — I'm used to getting up early

pairs.a: I used to have long hair.
I used to get up early.
pairs.b: I'm used to getting up early.

en: I used to smoke.
